summary: Biophytis SA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating progress on its Hong Kong joint venture, Biophytis Biopharmaceutical Holding LTD, formed with Asian partners including Ronghui Renhe Life Technology. The update covers planned IP contribution (BIO101 patents for China, Japan, South Korea), a licensing agreement with single-digit royalties, an initial $3M funding tranche toward a $20M total commitment ($10M in year one), and preparation for a Phase 3 sarcopenia trial. This is a routine operational update on a previously announced collaboration, not a special-situation event. No new terms, prices, or structural changes are disclosed, and the non-US issuer's report is filed as a foreign private issuer update.
